Vermont Bicycle Shop Pizza Ride

Barre, VT · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Vermont Bicycle Shop Pizza Ride is a social group ride in Barre, VT. It rolls first Saturday of the month at 4:00 pm from Vermont Bicycle Shop, Barre. Pace: casual, family friendly, about 30 minutes. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 4:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, family friendly, about 30 minutes. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @vermontbicycleshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Vermont Bicycle Shop Pizza Ride group ride

About thirty minutes of the easiest riding Barre has, then pizza. The shop's ride club also runs a weekly women-led beginner MTB hour at Millstone and a weekly training ride; updates go on the club site and Instagram.
